title: Deductions from a TRICARE Prime Proration Credit
content:
**Points of judgement.** From the value of the counted months of a TRICARE Prime proration credit, one amount comes off, read from the entries against the credited installment:

1. Where credits were already posted against the credited installment, they come off.
2. Where none were but refunds stand against its latest payment, those refunds come off.
3. Otherwise the amount by which the payments against it fall short of its charge comes off.

## Cases (hypothetical, credited installment 390.12, counted months valued at 162.55)

| Entries against the installment | Comes off | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| a credit of 130.04 already posted | 130.04 | 32.51 |
| no credit; a refund of 20.00 against the latest payment | 20.00 | 142.55 |
| no credit, no refund; payments of 390.12 | 0.00 | 162.55 |
| no credit, no refund; payments of 350.00 | 40.12 | 122.43 |
